title: Protein massively parallel binding assay reveals transcription factor binding determinants
authors: Offir Lupo; Sagie Brodsky; Tamar Jana Lang; Wajd Manadre; Gili Valinsky; Yoav Navon; Vladimir Mindel; Naama Barkai
one_liner_zh: 该文开发pMPBA高通量实验方法扫描酵母转录因子肽段与DNA结合，虽聚焦TF-DNA互作但以实验为主，缺乏AI或物理模拟建模，方法轴不足。
abstract: Transcription factors select their genomic binding sites in genomes depending on their DNA binding domain (DBD) but also on regions outside the DBD (nonDBD). However, it remains challenging to define these determinants within nonDBDs and reveal their mechanism of action. Towards this, we introduce here an in-vivo method for parallel analysis of thousands of designed peptides for binding a DNA sequence of interest (Protein Massively Parallel Binding Assay, pMPBA). We apply it to scan the full sequence space of budding yeast TFs and generate a detailed map of DNA localizing determinants. Within the set of predicted DBDs, we reveal a large variation in DNA binding affinities, depending on the family and on different sequence characteristics, including charge. Strong signals were not confined to predicted DBDs but included a considerable fraction of nonDBD peptides, most of which were predicted as intrinsically disordered. pMPBA opens new possibilities for high-throughput analysis of peptide-DNA binding within cells.
abstract_zh: 转录因子在基因组中选择其基因组结合位点，取决于其DNA结合域（DBD），也取决于DBD之外的区域（nonDBD）。然而，在nonDBD内定义这些决定因素并揭示其作用机制仍具挑战性。为此，我们在此介绍一种体内方法，用于平行分析数千种设计肽段与目标DNA序列的结合（蛋白质大规模平行结合分析，pMPBA）。我们将其应用于扫描芽殖酵母转录因子的全序列空间，并生成DNA定位决定因素的详细图谱。在预测的DBD集合中，我们揭示了DNA结合亲和力的大幅变异，这取决于家族及不同序列特征，包括电荷。强信号不仅限于预测的DBD，还包括相当一部分nonDBD肽段，其中大多数被预测为内在无序。pMPBA为细胞内肽-DNA结合的高通量分析开辟了新可能性。
